crossRefs.note: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in…
Yahweh struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.
translations.bsb: That day 25,000 Benjamite swordsmen fell, all men of valor.
translations.kjv: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.
translations.asv: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valor.
